# uptimeeye_notification_channel (Resource)

A notification channel groups one or more notification integrations (Slack, email, webhook, ...) and is referenced by monitors and scheduled tasks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeeye_notification_channel" "oncall" {
  name = "On-Call"
  tags = ["managed-by:terraform"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the channel.

### Optional

- `tags` (List of String) Tags for organizing channels.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel identifier.
